Kit summary

Twin Fang Soul-severBasic
Attacks a single enemy twice, dealing 200% ATK DMG each time. The 2nd stage of DMG inflicts 1 layer of [Blade Erosion] on the target.
Bloodblade BreachActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Inflicts 1 layer of [Blade Erosion] on all enemies. Then attacks all enemies twice, dealing 150% ATK DMG each time; for each layer of [Oni Remnant] self has, each stage deals an extra 1% ATK DMG. The 2nd stage of DMG inflicts 1 layer of [Vulnerability] on targets with full layers of [Blade Erosion], up to 3 layers.
Bloodblade Resheath Lv.1When an ally uses a skill to pursue and attack during Kijuro's turn, or when an ally deals Direct DMG to a Boss, Kijuro uses <Bloodblade Breach> to pursue and attack once. This effect can trigger at most once before Kijuro acts. When self uses <Bloodblade Breach> to pursue and attack, increases self ATK by 10%, stackable up to 4 times; removes all buffs from the Boss, and caps the DMG it deals in the next 2 turns at 25% of Kijuro's Max HP. The DMG dealt by <Bloodblade Breach> to Bosses is increased by 30%. Each layer of [Oni Remnant] additionally increases self Direct DMG dealt by 2%. While self is in [Sheathed] state, enemies cannot use basic attacks to pursue and attack.
Bloodblade Resheath Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, increases the Turn Meter of the ally with the highest initial ATK and the ally with the highest initial HP by 50%. When allies' skill pursue-and-attacks reach a total of 4, grants self 1 layer of [Oni Backlash], up to 3 layers. When an enemy uses a skill to pursue and attack, if self has [Oni Backlash], consumes 1 layer to invalidate that pursue-and-attack skill. When an enemy casts a non-pursuit skill outside of their own turn, if self has [Oni Backlash], consumes 1 layer to reduce the Skill DMG of that cast by 40%. When [Oni Backlash] is consumed, uses <Bloodblade Breach> to pursue and attack once, and inflicts 1 layer of [Vulnerability] on all enemies. When a new turn is gained through <Oni: Hidden Edge>, reduces the CD of <Bloodblade Breach> and <Sanzu Funeral> by 1 turn.
Oni's Hidden EdgePassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
Kijuro's basic attack DMG and skill DMG are guaranteed not to Crit against non-Boss units, and are guaranteed to Crit against Boss units. At the beginning of a battle and at the beginning of self turn, grants self 1 layer of [Oni Remnant] for every 10% of self Crit DMG (each layer increases Skill DMG by 3% and basic attack DMG by 3%). Layers are rounded down, and re-granting refreshes the number of layers. At the beginning of a battle, enters [Sheathed] state. At the beginning of self turn, if in [Sheathed] state, exits this state and enters [Unsheathed] state (increases basic attack DMG and skill DMG dealt by 50%), lasting until the end of self turn. When actively casting a skill during self turn, if in [Unsheathed] state, uses <Bloodblade Breach> to pursue and attack once. Each time <Bloodblade Breach> or <Sanzu Funeral> is used to pursue and attack, grants self 1 layer of [Blood Charge]. When stacked to 3 layers, consumes 3 layers of [Blood Charge] and gains 1 new turn.
Bloodblade Resheath Lv.1When an ally uses a skill to pursue and attack during Kijuro's turn, or when an ally deals Direct DMG to a Boss, Kijuro uses <Bloodblade Breach> to pursue and attack once. This effect can trigger at most once before Kijuro acts. When self uses <Bloodblade Breach> to pursue and attack, increases self ATK by 10%, stackable up to 4 times; removes all buffs from the Boss, and caps the DMG it deals in the next 2 turns at 25% of Kijuro's Max HP. The DMG dealt by <Bloodblade Breach> to Bosses is increased by 30%. Each layer of [Oni Remnant] additionally increases self Direct DMG dealt by 2%. While self is in [Sheathed] state, enemies cannot use basic attacks to pursue and attack.
Bloodblade Resheath Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, increases the Turn Meter of the ally with the highest initial ATK and the ally with the highest initial HP by 50%. When allies' skill pursue-and-attacks reach a total of 4, grants self 1 layer of [Oni Backlash], up to 3 layers. When an enemy uses a skill to pursue and attack, if self has [Oni Backlash], consumes 1 layer to invalidate that pursue-and-attack skill. When an enemy casts a non-pursuit skill outside of their own turn, if self has [Oni Backlash], consumes 1 layer to reduce the Skill DMG of that cast by 40%. When [Oni Backlash] is consumed, uses <Bloodblade Breach> to pursue and attack once, and inflicts 1 layer of [Vulnerability] on all enemies. When a new turn is gained through <Oni: Hidden Edge>, reduces the CD of <Bloodblade Breach> and <Sanzu Funeral> by 1 turn.
Bloodblade Resheath Lv.3After <Sanzu Funeral> deals DMG, if the target's current HP is not lower than 50% of its Max HP, additionally deals DMG equal to 5% of the target's Max HP; otherwise, additionally deals DMG equal to 10% of the target's lost HP. The extra DMG cannot exceed 100% of Kijuro's ATK. When hitting a Boss, additionally increases the Direct DMG and Skill DMG it takes by 30%. At the beginning of a battle, grants self 2 layers of [Soul Cocoon]. When entering [Unsheathed] state, settles and removes all allies' recorded DMG effects, then consumes all of self's [Soul Cocoon]; for each layer consumed, restores all allies' HP by 300% of Kijuro's ATK. If 5 allies with the [Pursue & Attack] tag are deployed, then: 1. After actively casting <Sanzu Funeral>, grants self layers of [Soul Cocoon] equal to the highest number of [Vulnerability] layers removed from a single enemy this time, up to 3 layers; if no [Vulnerability] is removed, grants 1 layer. 2. While self is in [Sheathed] state, when an enemy casts a basic attack or skill, consumes 1 layer of [Soul Cocoon] so that this DMG does not exceed 25% of Kijuro's Max HP. Afterwards, increases self Turn Meter by 20%, restores all allies' HP by 300% of Kijuro's ATK, and inflicts 1 layer of [Vulnerability] on the DMG source. This effect can trigger at most once per unit each turn. 3. When consuming [Soul Cocoon], grants all allies [Oni Garb] (absorbs DMG equal to 1000% of Kijuro's ATK, considered as a Shield; cannot be stolen or removed; stacks up to 2 layers), reduces the basic attack DMG and skill DMG taken by all allies by 40%, and increases the basic attack DMG and skill DMG dealt by them by 40% for 2 turns.
Sanzu FuneralActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Inflicts 2 layers of [Blade Erosion] on all enemies (each layer increases the Skill DMG taken by 5% and reduces the Skill DMG dealt by 5%, up to 6 layers). Then attacks all enemies 3 times, dealing 200% ATK DMG each time; for each layer of [Oni Remnant] self has, each stage deals an extra 2% ATK DMG. When dealing DMG to targets with [Vulnerability], ignores their Shield, and for each layer of [Vulnerability] the target has, the DMG dealt this time is increased by 10%. When the skill ends, removes all [Vulnerability] from all enemies. At the end of the turn in which <Sanzu Funeral> is cast, enters [Sheathed] state (reduces the basic attack DMG and skill DMG taken by 50%).
